name: Band triceps extension

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower your hand behind your head

formTips: Stand on one end of the band and hold the other end in one hand behind your head
Point your elbow at the ceiling, close to your ear
Straighten your arm overhead; only your forearm moves
Lower your hand slowly behind your head
Do all the reps on one side, then switch arms
commonMistakes: Letting the elbow drift forward or out to the side
Letting the band pull the hand down fast
Stopping short of a straight arm
